page: Microsoft Azure M176bds_v3 is a high-capacity server belonging to the MBDSMediumMemoryv3 family. It is powered by dedicated Intel Xeon 8473C processors utilizing the x86_64 architecture, delivering 176 vCPUs across 88 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The CPU operates at a clock speed of 4.0 GHz and features a 105 MB L3 cache. It is equipped with 1536.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 8.73 GB of RAM per physical core. Local storage is provided via a 410 GB local disk, and the instance supports high-performance block storage and premium storage configurations.

Benchmark data highlights top-tier performance across multiple domains. Multi-core processing is exceptionally strong, with stress-ng multi-core CPU scores and PassMark CPU scores placing in the top 10% of tested systems. Memory bandwidth is a key strength, achieving read-only cached speeds of 11,579.05 GB/sec and uncached large-block read speeds of 432.14 GB/sec. Database operations and key-value store performance are highly optimized, as evidenced by top-tier PassMark database operations and Redis SET performance reaching 170.86 million operations per second. Single-core performance is moderate, placing in the middle 50% for stress-ng single-core tests, indicating that workloads must be highly parallelized to fully leverage this hardware profile.

The underlying Intel Xeon processor supports advanced instruction sets, including AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) for deep learning and matrix operations. These hardware accelerators contribute to strong performance in CPU-based LLM inference, where prompt processing for 135M, 7B, and 70B models consistently ranks in the top 25%. This server is highly suited for memory-intensive databases, large-scale software compilation, high-throughput web serving, and parallelized data processing tasks.
